news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published full peer-reviewed efficacy, safety, PK/PD and biomarker data from the induction period of the Phase 2b trial, confirming the study met all primary and key secondary endpoints; shares pushed to fresh 52-week highs around $79 on the news.

news.headline: Sell-side splits on Nektar after Q2 print: Canaccord initiates Buy, JPMorgan reinstates Neutral
news.summary: Canaccord's Edward Nash initiated coverage with a Buy and $153 price target, Piper Sandler reiterated Buy at $185, while JPMorgan reinstated coverage at Neutral, all citing the strengthened cash position and rezpegaldesleukin momentum.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.1M with a net loss of $40.6M; cash and investments stood at roughly $1.02B (up from $245.8M at year-end 2025 after two 2026 equity raises), giving runway into Q3 2028.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed first patients in the registrational ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2 trials, with a third pivotal study (AD-3) targeting treatment-experienced patients to begin in September 2026.

catalysts.label: EADV 2026 oral presentation of REZOLVE-AA 52-week alopecia areata data
catalysts.detail: Oral presentation (Abstract AS-1872, session FC04.1D) detailing 52-week efficacy/safety results from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal trial in the ZENITH AD program, enrolling treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial start
catalysts.detail: Planned registrational study in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata building on Fast Track designation and positive Phase 2b data.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly financial results and pipeline update.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD topline data
catalysts.detail: First readouts expected from the registrational atopic dermatitis program.

catalysts.label: Targeted first BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Company-guided target for rezpegaldesleukin's first regulatory filing, in atopic dermatitis.

pulse: NKTR shares are trading near fresh 52-week highs (around $75-79) after the August 25 Lancet publication of positive REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b data reinforced conviction in lead asset rezpegaldesleukin, following an already-strong Q2 print showing roughly $1.0B in cash (runway into Q3 2028) after two large 2026 equity raises. Sell-side sentiment has turned decisively bullish with a wave of Buy initiations/reiterations (Canaccord, Piper Sandler, Oppenheimer, TD Cowen) and rising price targets, though JPMorgan remains on the sidelines at Neutral. Near-term catalysts are data-presentation and trial-progression events (EADV alopecia data on October 1, ZENITH AD-3 initiation in September) rather than binary readouts, with the first pivotal atopic dermatitis topline data not expected until mid-2028.
